negative_prior.development: NO_GO; temporal and one-step JEPA predictive heads inferior to native conditional Brier on 2 seeds; do not reuse/tune scored cohorts

question: Can the existing native cumulative learner with four independent trained JEPA heads be continued through novel multi-variable causal dynamics while two additional independently trainable action-conditioned future-state JEPA heads learn 3-step sensory and reward representations with a learned stop-gradient teacher, yielding better multi-step observed consequence predictions without damaging prior native knowledge?

source.kind: NEW disjoint synthetic development family, not private research primary science or real physical world
source.old_state_sha256: must be verified at run from original prior-branch immutable files and exact parent commit
source.family: four observed bits (three sensor bits plus reward), hidden delayed intermediate mediator, two predetermined public interventions per step, two distinct causal logic families, deterministic hidden rule A/B/A shifts; planned actions for t,t+1,t+2 publicly frozen before scoring, revealed public outcomes after scoring only
source.exclusions: no old CKAD37 generator, no scored 88901/88917 replay, no hidden regime labels or simulator latent state given to any learner
source.first_use_status: development synthetic source generation, not protected scientific first-use

model.native: one persistent original NativeTemporalMultiLearner, with NativeEpisodeExperience and prior four independent trained specialists carried through each public observed intervention, exact original ledger prefix and learned source checkpoints preserved
model.new: two independent learned future-state specialists, sensory 3x3-bit target and reward 3-bit target; no tokens or transformers
model.prediction: at t predict public sensor and consequence observations at t,t+1,t+2 given current 3-bit public observation, three announced 2-action interventions, and preceding four verified public outcomes
model.timing: score before observing any future outcome; train target/predictor only once entire three-step actual future observation vector has been revealed, never using future labels earlier
model.teacher: EMA teacher encoder of multi-step public future observations (momentum=0.98), stop-gradient latent target; online future encoder separately reconstructs public target bits and prevents trivial latent collapse; predictor latent to outcome readout is learned concurrently
model.checkpoint: cold versioned source-bound artifact contains old exact native checkpoint and all six learned heads; reject source mutation and forged new head weights by full ledger/source replay on cold restore; canonical SHA and tolerance 1e-7

frozen.initial: deterministic sin/cos with seed-independent specialist salt
frozen.anti_collapse: future encoder trained on observed target bit reconstruction and per-head latent variance must exceed 0.002 on scored windows
frozen.all_results_single_preset: one seed pair, no post-result tuning

controls: original continued native context learner with action marginalization and no future-state leakage
fully trained online direct-logistic next-three multi-label predictor with same current view/planned actions/history and same update opportunities
Beta conditional counts using same public viewed state and announced intervention sequence, 3-horizon and optional sliding-window 24/48
same capacity future-state predictor with deliberately mismatched future observation triples (previous unrelated verified target), matched train steps and input/action information
frozen old one-step+temporal JEPA continuation readouts and fixed .5 sham
no-history and no-action development ablation, no future label lookahead

metrics.primary: prequential pooled Brier on six 3-step native-supported public outcomes (three observed s2 + three rewards) in new A/B/A late-B and return-A phases
secondary: native old source prefix and original performance cold retention
multi-platform deterministic source receipts and costs
metrics.success: On BOTH new dev seeds new future-state combined readout must beat strongest fully trained native/original and best conventional by >=.005 pooled six-bit Brier; beat same-size mispaired by >=.010, old 32 receipts old native Brier no worse by .03; all source/ledger/cold/negative guards pass and target variance >=.002. Otherwise DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO, preserve negative without tuning.
metrics.scientific: SCIENCE_PASS always false; new synthetic family and same developer authorship are not independent science
